cases.title: Narrow vs wide glyphs
cases.why: char-count interpolation assumes every letter has the same width

cases.title: Long single-chunk lines
cases.why: error accumulates toward the end of a long text item

cases.title: Monospace control
cases.why: equal widths: interpolation is exact here, useful as a control group

cases.title: Condensed, geometric and old-style fonts
cases.why: fallback sans-serif in the text layer differs a lot from these

cases.title: Extreme sizes in one line
cases.why: line height and baseline shift when size changes mid-line; 4.5 pt text

cases.title: Drop cap
cases.why: first word split across two text objects with different size and baseline

cases.title: Script font with overhangs
cases.why: ink extends far outside the advance box; ascent/descent are huge

cases.title: Letter spacing (Tc)
cases.why: every glyph advance grows by Tc; the text layer must apply it too

cases.title: Justification with word spacing (Tw)
cases.why: Word/LibreOffice style: spaces are stretched with Tw

cases.title: Manual justification, one Tj per word
cases.why: InDesign/Chrome print style: every word positioned separately

cases.title: Horizontal scaling (Tz)
cases.why: Tz squeezes or stretches glyphs and spacing

cases.title: TJ kerning instead of spaces (pdfTeX)
cases.why: words are separated only by TJ offsets, there is no space character

cases.title: Per-glyph positioning
cases.why: some producers emit one text object per glyph (PDF printers, ghostscript)

cases.title: Negative letter spacing
cases.why: tight tracking: glyph boxes overlap

cases.title: Symbols from a second font
cases.why: the line switches fonts for ± μ ×; widths differ from the fallback

cases.title: Inline math
cases.why: big operators, italic variables, sub/superscripts with Ts rise

cases.title: Superscript citations and footnotes
cases.why: small raised text attached to words

cases.title: Chemical subscripts
cases.why: subscripts lowered with negative Ts inside a word

cases.title: Bold / italic inside one word
cases.why: one logical word spans three fonts

cases.title: Size change mid-sentence
cases.why: sentence highlight must cover lines with mixed heights

cases.title: Coloured and serif/sans switch
cases.why: link-like coloured text in another font

cases.title: Ligature glyphs
cases.why: one glyph = two or three letters; pdf.js normalizes ﬁ → fi so char offsets shift

cases.title: No-break and thin spaces
cases.why: NBSP U+00A0, thin U+2009, narrow NBSP U+202F; word splitting differs

cases.title: Private Use Area in ToUnicode
cases.why: the extracted text contains U+F0A0 instead of a space (Word + Symbol font); backend tokens break

cases.title: Precomposed vs decomposed diacritics
cases.why: NFC vs NFD: same visual word, different character count

cases.title: Hyphenation across lines
cases.why: one logical word is split over two lines and two rectangles

cases.title: Dashes, quotes, URLs, numbers
cases.why: punctuation-heavy tokens and tokenizer edge cases

cases.title: Very long words
cases.why: single token much longer than average

cases.title: Soft hyphen and zero-width characters
cases.why: invisible characters inside words change offsets but not geometry

cases.title: Hebrew (RTL, visual order)
cases.why: glyphs are stored right-to-left; word order on screen is reversed

cases.title: Mixed LTR + RTL line
cases.why: bidi line: English words with embedded Hebrew

cases.title: Arabic presentation forms
cases.why: contextual glyph forms (U+FExx) in visual order

cases.title: CJK without spaces
cases.why: no whitespace between words; segmentation needs a dictionary (Intl.Segmenter)

cases.title: Vertical CJK as stacked glyphs
cases.why: top-to-bottom text built from single-glyph objects

cases.title: Greek and Cyrillic
cases.why: non-Latin alphabets with different widths

cases.title: Rotated text
cases.why: rectangles must be rotated quads, not axis-aligned boxes

cases.title: Font size inside the text matrix
cases.why: Tf size is 1 and Tm carries the scale (very common in real PDFs)

cases.title: Non-uniform scale and shear
cases.why: Tm with different x/y scale, and synthetic italic via shear

cases.title: Text inside a Form XObject
cases.why: the form has its own matrix; positions must include it

cases.title: Mirrored text
cases.why: negative x scale: text reads right-to-left as a mirror image

cases.title: Two columns, 6 pt gutter
cases.why: line merging across columns produces one huge rectangle

cases.title: Content stream order ≠ reading order
cases.why: right column drawn first, lines bottom-up; extraction order is scrambled

cases.title: Table with aligned numbers
cases.why: cells are separate items; right-aligned numbers; grid lines

cases.title: Fake bold by double printing
cases.why: the same text is painted twice with a 0.35 pt offset; extraction may duplicate words

cases.title: Invisible text
cases.why: white text, text under an opaque box, render mode 3; should NOT be read or highlighted

cases.title: Microprint and huge display text
cases.why: 1 pt text and a 60 pt word

cases.title: Good OCR layer (per-word)
cases.why: outlines + invisible text scaled per word; close match

cases.title: Sloppy OCR layer (per-line)
cases.why: invisible text fitted per line only, baseline 2 pt off, smaller font

cases.title: Skewed scan
cases.why: scan rotated 1.5°, OCR text left axis-aligned

cases.title: Outlines without any text
cases.why: nothing to extract: only OCR or backend data can locate these words

cases.title: Page with /Rotate 90
cases.why: viewport rotation: page coordinates ≠ screen coordinates

cases.title: CropBox smaller than MediaBox
cases.why: origin of the visible page is offset; text outside the crop is invisible

cases.title: Small page size (A6)
cases.why: pages of different sizes in one document

cases.title: Landscape MediaBox (no /Rotate)
cases.why: wide page; long lines of 100+ characters

cases.title: Composite two-column article 1
cases.why: all common traps mixed in running text: ligatures, symbols from another font, NBSP, Tw and TJ justification

cases.title: Composite two-column article 2
cases.why: all common traps mixed in running text: ligatures, symbols from another font, NBSP, Tw and TJ justification

cases.title: Running header and page number
cases.why: repeated on every page; a reader usually skips them (meta.role)

cases.title: Chapter opener on a coloured band
cases.why: white text on a fill, letter-spaced kicker, 34 pt title

cases.title: Three-line drop cap
cases.why: a 54 pt "W" beside three indented lines; the word "Water" is split into two text objects of very different size

cases.title: Raised initial and small-caps lead-in
cases.why: a 30 pt "E" on the baseline, the rest of the first words in 8 pt capitals: one word, three sizes

cases.title: Text wrapping around a photo
cases.why: lines next to the photo are shorter than the lines below it; the caption sits between them

cases.title: Inline icons inside sentences
cases.why: pictures sit between words; one picture replaces a word that is not in the text at all

cases.title: Sentence interrupted by a figure
cases.why: one sentence starts above a full-width photo and ends below it

cases.title: Sidebar box (key term)
cases.why: a boxed note beside the main text; reading order: main text first, then the box

cases.title: Margin note
cases.why: small coloured note in a separate margin column next to the paragraph

cases.title: Bulleted and numbered lists
cases.why: bullets and numbers are separate items; wrapped lines use a hanging indent

cases.title: Exercise blanks and checkboxes
cases.why: underscore runs and box glyphs between words; "true/false" options

cases.title: Footnote markers and footnotes
cases.why: small raised numbers in the text, small text at the page bottom under a rule

cases.title: Pull quote
cases.why: large italic quote with oversized quotation marks in another colour

cases.title: Picture initial
cases.why: the first letter is an image; the text only contains "nce upon a time"

cases.title: Outlined initial and boxed initial
cases.why: a vector "T" with no text behind it, and a white "R" inside a coloured square

cases.title: Diagram with scattered labels
cases.why: short labels around a vector drawing, one of them rotated, with leader lines

cases.title: Chart with text baked into the image
cases.why: title and axis labels are pixels; pdf.js finds no text there (extractable=false)

cases.title: White text over a photo
cases.why: the caption is drawn on top of the picture in white

cases.title: Photo covering part of the text
cases.why: words under the picture are still in the text layer but not visible (visible=false)

cases.title: Photo inside a column
cases.why: two columns; the left column is interrupted by a photo and continues below it
